name: Supine Leg March
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands gently on your lower abdomen to feel your deep core muscles engage.
Draw your belly button gently inward to flatten your lower back slightly against the mat.
Slowly lift your right foot off the floor, bringing your right knee to a 90-degree angle without moving your pelvis.
Lower the right foot back down with control and repeat the movement with your left foot.
coaching_cues: Imagine your pelvis is set in concrete; it should not tilt or wobble as your feet lift.
Keep the movement slow, rhythmic, and quiet.
Exhale on the lift and inhale as the foot returns to the floor.
